reason: The steel can form a cooker around the existing pressure pot.
expectation: This should build a cooker assembly ready to connect to the solar heat source.

effect: The pot now has a jacket and clamp for the furnace connection.
reaction: The removable cradle makes the connection feel practical.
reason: The jacket is designed to connect the pot to the existing solar heat source.
expectation: The pot should connect to the solar heating block, completing the cooker.

effect: The jacketed pot connects to the controlled heating block, completing the cooker while keeping industrial materials away from the food.
reaction: The conductive connection and food separation make the cooker feel physically sensible, though I expected to prepare the meal as well.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the jacketed pot to the solar heating block was most worthwhile: it made the heat path and separation from industrial materials clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: The chapter ended after building the cooker, so the promised harvest meal never happened. That felt abrupt.

surprise.text: I expected the cooker to be a step toward making stew, but completing it ended the chapter.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the jacket and clamp gave the two combinations a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue to see the harvest meal and the eventual return, although this chapter's abrupt ending left little opportunity for discovery.
